# Construct BIBD(9,3,3) using 3 copies of AG(2,3)

v = 9
k = 3
lam = 3

# AG(2,3): points 0..8 representing (x,y) with x,y in {0,1,2}
# point index = x*3 + y

# Lines of AG(2,3):
lines = []

# Horizontal: y = c
for c in range(3):
    line = [x*3 + c for x in range(3)]
    lines.append(line)

# Vertical: x = c
for c in range(3):
    line = [c*3 + y for y in range(3)]
    lines.append(line)

# Diagonal: y = x + c (mod 3)
for c in range(3):
    line = [(x*3 + (x + c) % 3) for x in range(3)]
    lines.append(line)

# Other diagonal: y = 2x + c (mod 3)
for c in range(3):
    line = [(x*3 + (2*x + c) % 3) for x in range(3)]
    lines.append(line)

print("Number of lines:", len(lines))
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    print(f"Line {i}: {line}")

# Verify AG(2,3) properties

for line in lines:
    for p in line:
        point_counts[p] += 1
print("Point counts:", point_counts)

for line in lines:

        for j in range(i+1, 3):

            if p1 > p2:
                p1, p2 = p2, p1
            pair_counts[(p1, p2)] = pair_counts.get((p1, p2), 0) + 1
print("Pair counts (should all be 1):", set(pair_counts.values()))

all_lines = lines * 3

# Build incidence matrix: 9 rows x 36 columns

    for p in line:
        matrix[p][j] = 1

# Verify

print("Row sums:", row_sums, "all 12?", all(s == 12 for s in row_sums))

col_sums = [sum(matrix[i][j] for i in range(9)) for j in range(36)]
print("Col sums:", col_sums, "all 3?", all(s == 3 for s in col_sums))

# Pairwise inner products
ok = True
for i1 in range(9):
